historical_knowledge_policy: These are retrospective development data. Hiding labels does not remove pretrained historical knowledge. Do not claim prospective forecasting skill; preserve future timestamped forecasts as a separate benchmark. No SFT targets are created from realized outcomes.
rationale: Additive scope review of 146 native contracts and 32 planned scheduled releases against the same 2244-entry ForecastBench index. The previous full 250 native-question / 250 series-template review remains applicable; additional economic-target review distinguishes 2024-11 through 2025-06 US CPI-U annual NSA and U-3 SA first releases from future 2026 series horizons, multi-year AI unemployment thresholds, and GDP-defined recession targets. No same-release CPI/U-3 target found. Shared macro drivers remain; no statistical-independence claim. Annual/monthly CPI sibling parents refer to the same BLS release but monthly parents remain excluded, as do annual-maxima and other-country markets. No inference from mere absence of exact matches.
reviewed_by: Codex source/scope review; not an independent human certification
